reference_notes.table12_conditions: Non-stressed, well-managed crops in subhumid climates, minimum RH about 45% and wind at 2 m about 2 m/s.
reference_notes.initial_stage_caveat: Initial Kc is strongly affected by wetting frequency and exposed wet soil; source group values are not automatic local defaults.
reference_notes.later_stage_caveat: Mid/end coefficients can require local humidity, wind, crop-height and management adjustment; harvest condition matters.
reference_notes.root_depth_caveat: Ranges are maximum effective rooting depths, not an observed root-depth trajectory. Restrict to actual soil/rootable profile when developing a validated model.
reference_notes.depletion_caveat: Table 22 depletion values depend on ET and crop/soil; the rice saturation footnote must remain separate.

source_depletion_fraction.basis: 0.20 of saturation, Table 22 footnote 4; do not treat as ordinary upland p times TAW

crop_specific_limits: Flooded rice water regime is not established by selecting the species.
Paddy preparation, standing water, seepage and percolation need separate accounting.

crops.kc_initial_basis: cereals group row; not a separately calibrated maize measurement

source_depletion_fraction.basis: p at crop ET about 5 mm/day, Table 22

crop_specific_limits: Grain maize reference does not represent sweet corn.
The two end coefficients reflect different harvest moisture/maturity conditions; no midpoint is selected.

crops.kc_initial_basis: legumes group row; not a separately calibrated soybean measurement

source_depletion_fraction.basis: p at crop ET about 5 mm/day, Table 22

crop_specific_limits: Reference coefficients are not a local cultivar or nodulation model.
